english: Let $z=\dfrac{\sqrt{6}}{4}\left(\sqrt{3}+i\right)$, where $i=\sqrt{-1}$. Then the value of $\displaystyle\sum_{k=0}^{4}z^{k}\,\bar{z}^{\,4-k}$ is ______.
hindi: माना कि $z=\dfrac{\sqrt{6}}{4}\left(\sqrt{3}+i\right)$ है, जहाँ $i=\sqrt{-1}$ है। तब $\displaystyle\sum_{k=0}^{4}z^{k}\,\bar{z}^{\,4-k}$ का मान ______ है।
solution: The sum is a GP in $\dfrac{z}{\bar{z}}$: $\displaystyle\sum_{k=0}^{4}z^{k}\bar{z}^{4-k}=\dfrac{z^{5}-\bar{z}^{5}}{z-\bar{z}}$ ($z\neq\bar{z}$)
solution_full: Each term is $z^{k}\bar{z}^{4-k}=r^{4}e^{i(2k-4)\pi/6}$, so the sum is $r^{4}\left(e^{-2i\pi/3}+e^{-i\pi/3}+1+e^{i\pi/3}+e^{2i\pi/3}\right)$.
Equivalently, since $z\neq\bar{z}$, the five terms form a GP with ratio $\dfrac{z}{\bar{z}}$, and $\displaystyle\sum_{k=0}^{4}z^{k}\bar{z}^{4-k}=\dfrac{z^{5}-\bar{z}^{5}}{z-\bar{z}}$.
By De Moivre's theorem, $z^{5}=r^{5}e^{5i\pi/6}$, so $z^{5}-\bar{z}^{5}=2ir^{5}\sin\dfrac{5\pi}{6}=ir^{5}$; and $z-\bar{z}=2ir\sin\dfrac{\pi}{6}=ir$.
Check with the bracket: $1+2\cos\dfrac{\pi}{3}+2\cos\dfrac{2\pi}{3}=1+1-1=1$, so the sum is $r^{4}\cdot1=2.25$.
originality_note: New: a symmetric sum of mixed powers of z and zbar is a GP whose sum is (z^5 - zbar^5)/(z - zbar) = r^4 sin 5theta / sin theta, real by symmetry (way 4, hidden structure). Closest known: sums of cos k theta via De Moivre; (z^n + zbar^n) = 2 r^n cos n theta. Different because: the sum must first be seen as a GP in z/zbar and then reduced with De Moivre on both conjugates.
blueprint_concepts: Conjugate, modulus and argument of a complex number
Polar form and exponential form of complex number

concept_use.Conjugate, modulus and argument of a com: |z|^2 = 3/2 and arg z = pi/6 are read off; zbar = r e^{-i pi/6}; z - zbar = 2i Im z.
concept_use.Polar form and exponential form of compl: z = r e^{i pi/6} makes each term r^4 e^{i(2k-4)pi/6} and the GP ratio z/zbar = e^{i pi/3}.
concept_use.De Moivre theorem: z^5 - zbar^5 = 2i r^5 sin(5 pi/6) by De Moivre's theorem.

key_step: See the sum as the GP (z^5 - zbar^5)/(z - zbar) and evaluate with De Moivre in polar form.
justification: Three linked standard steps (polar form, GP of conjugate powers, De Moivre) with a non-obvious first move, numerical answer. Borderline 2-3; comparable to 2025-P2-Q13 (L4) in topic but much lighter, so 3 with Medium confidence.

Checked that z is not real, so the GP form is valid, and that the sum is real. Answer 2.25, positive decimal. No change.
